camel_example: aliyun sas CreateHoneypotProbe --region cn-hangzhou --ProbeType host_probe --ControlNodeId 'a882e590-b87b-45a6-87b9-d0a3e5a00000' --DisplayName testHoneyPotProbe
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-honeypot-probe --control-node-id a882e590-b87b-45a6-87b9-d0a3e5a00000 --probe-type host_probe --display-name testHoneyPotProbe --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHoneypotProbe

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the management node.

You can call the [ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~) operation to query the IDs of management nodes
parameters.help_zh:
管理节点ID。
您可以调用[ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~)接口获取该值
parameters.name: control_node_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the probe. Valid values:

host_probe: host probe
vpc_black_hole_probe: virtual private cloud (VPC) probe
parameters.help_zh:
探针类型。取值：

host_probe：主机探针

vpc_black_hole_probe：VPC黑洞探针
parameters.name: probe_type

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the instance.

If ProbeType is set to host_probe, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
实例UUID。
ProbeType为host_probe时该值不能为空
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business group
parameters.name: business_group_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to bind a port. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
fields.help_zh:
是否绑定端口。取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: bind_port

fields.help_en: The end of the port range
fields.name: end_port

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the port is a fixed port. Valid values:

0: no
1: yes
fields.help_zh:
是否固定端口。取值：

0：否
1：是
fields.name: fixed

fields.help_en: The start of the port range
fields.name: start_port

fields.help_en:
The destination port.

If HoneypotId is specified, this parameter is required
fields.help_zh:
目标端口。
HoneypotId不为空时该值不能为空
fields.name: target_port

fields.help_en:
The ID of the honeypot.

You can call the [ListHoneypot](~~ListHoneypot~~) operation to query the IDs of honeypots
fields.help_zh:
蜜罐ID。
您可以调用[ListHoneypot](~~ListHoneypot~~)接口获取该值
fields.name: honeypot_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable ping scan. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
ping扫描检测。取值：

true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: ping

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) spoofing. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
ARP欺骗检测。
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: arp

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC.

If ProbeType is set to vpc_black_hole_probe, this parameter is required. You can call the [DescribeVpcHoneyPotList](~~DescribeVpcHoneyPotList~~) operation to query the IDs of VPCs
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络的ID。

ProbeType为vpc_black_hole_probe时该值不能为空。 您可以调用[DescribeVpcHoneyPotList](~~DescribeVpcHoneyPotList~~)接口获取该值
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the proxy
parameters.name: proxy_ip
